overview: Vectored/non-vectored interrupts, priority (daisy chain), polling vs interrupt overhead, ISR handling.
coreConcept: Interrupt device ko CPU ka dhyan khinchne deta hai; polling me CPU baar-baar puchta hai.
hinglishExplanation: Vectored interrupt me device khud ISR address (vector) deta hai, isliye tez. Non-vectored me CPU ko address dhundna padta hai. Interrupt overhead vs byte transfer time compare karke % CPU time nikalte hain.
formalDefinition: Interrupt device ko CPU ka dhyan khinchne deta hai; polling me CPU baar-baar puchta hai.
importantProperties: Vectored: device vector supply karta hai; non-vectored: fixed/searched address.
Daisy chain priority assign karta hai.
ISR current instruction complete hone ke baad start hota hai.
CPU interrupt enable hone par hi process karta hai.
commonPitfalls: Polling interval ko time se confuse.
